subject: Zip invite fails at account linking step - MFA/tenant hint mismatch
messages:
From: Ashley Park <ashley.park@stratasys.io>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: procureops@zipvendor.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Zip invite for Strata - user can't complete linking (MFA fail)

Hi Jonas,

We're seeing one of our procurement users unable to complete the Zip supplier invite — it fails at the "link your account" step when they try to confirm MFA. The browser shows the standard Zip screen but after they enter the OTP/passkey it redirects back to our portal with an error: "tenant_hint_mismatch" and the account creation never completes.

I attached a screenshot and the browser console request headers. They tried accepting the invite twice. The user is the primary invoice approver for Strata (ashley+procure@stratasys.io).

Can you confirm whether the invite token needs to be reissued or if there's a configuration on our side (SSO/tenant mapping) that will resolve this? This is blocking our first PO to Redwood.

Thanks,
Ashley Park
Sr. Procurement Ops
Strata Systems

Attachment: screenshot-mfa-step.png
Attachment: invite-headers.txt

From: jonas.weber@redwood.com <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Park <ashley.park@stratasys.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Zip Support <procureops@zipvendor.com>
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip invite for Strata - user can't complete linking (MFA fail)

Hi Ashley — thanks for the quick note and attachments.

Quick checklist I ran through:
- The invite token looks valid (not expired) from our side.
- The header you sent shows a tenant_handoff="/t/strata-legacy" and an X-Invite-Token that maps to the new Zip environment; that mismatch is suspicious.
- The error message you pasted matches a case where the user's email already exists under a previously provisioned tenant alias, which can trigger an MFA flow bound to the legacy tenant context and then fail the linking step.

Two asks so we can move fast:
1) Can you reissue the invite from your Zip admin console but choose the "force tenant rebind" option (if available)? That has resolved a similar case before.
2) If reissue is not possible immediately, can you confirm the user's email alias history (has ashley+procure@ been used in other Strata subaccounts?) — that'll tell us if a manual claim is needed.

I'll loop Ben from Engineering if we need to patch a fallback for tenant-hint reconciliation on our redirect. If this is blocking the PO, Marissa, can you give Ashley a temporary manual activation on our side so they can receive POs while we fix the invite flow?

-Jonas
Jonas Weber
Onboarding Lead, Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: jonas.weber@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 12:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Zip invite for Strata - user can't complete linking (MFA fail)

Forwarding with notes for runtime/identity team — attaching the invite headers Ashley provided.

Repro notes from quick log check:
- Invite token X-Invite-Token=AB12-...(trimmed) is presented to /auth/link. Our redirect includes tenant_hint=/t/strata-legacy; Zip returns 302 to /error with query ?code=tenant_hint_mismatch.
- The user's identity exists in our DB as a shadow identity (email with previous alias). When link flow detects canonical mismatch we currently surface the error rather than attempt an overlay merge.

Suggested short-term mitigation:
- Add a one-time manual claim: surface a "This looks like an existing account — accept to merge" flow for invites when tenant hint doesn't match but email is verified. Engineering can flip a temporary flag to allow auto-claim for this tenant (audit logged).

Longer term: we should tolerate tenant_hint drift for Zip/Workday for customers with known alias histories and offer a safer merge UI.

I can pull the full runtime trace if you want — flagged ONB-4123.

Ben
Staff Infrastructure Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: marissa.cole@redwood.com <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Ashley Park <ashley.park@stratasys.io>
Cc: jonas.weber@redwood.com, ben.carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 01 Jun 2027 15:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Zip invite for Strata - user can't complete linking (MFA fail)

Hi Ashley — sorry for the interruption on your first PO. We can provide a short-term workaround so your team can continue while Engineering deploys a fix:

1) Jonas can create a manual vendor activation for the Strata supplier record so you can receive and pay PO #RDW-9843. That bypasses the Zip link until we confirm the tenant mapping.
2) If you prefer to keep onboarding via Zip, please ask your Zip admin to reissue the invite with "force tenant rebind" and share the new invite token so Ben can watch the logs in real time.

I'll coordinate the manual activation now — can you confirm the legal entity name and the remit-to email for invoices? Also, please tell me whether you want the onboarding completed under "Strata Systems (main)" or under the legacy org "Strata Procurement" so we set the right billing entity.

We'll aim to close this today.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachment: activation-checklist.pdf (stub)
